deploy_command: git push origin rc-2026-10-28 (deploy-production: validate = deploy/tests + RELEASE_TAG preflight + clinical gate + a successful staging deploy of the tagged commit; the deploy job runs only when PROD_DEPLOY_ENABLED=true). Local equivalent from a clean checkout of the tag, with the deploy/environments/production.env.example variables: RELEASE_TAG=rc-2026-10-28 bash deploy/deploy.sh production --dry-run, then RELEASE_TAG=rc-2026-10-28 bash deploy/deploy.sh production
rollback_command: bash deploy/rollback.sh production <backup id printed by the deploy ("Deployment passed; rollback backup: <id>", also in deploy/log/production.jsonl)>; overlay files only, the database is not touched; deploy/runbooks/runbook-rollback.md

restore_drill.full_backup_command: node tools/release/drill.mjs backup <staging|production> (tools/release/backup.py over SSH; DEC-19 retention)

signoffs.production_smoke: node tools/release/drill.mjs smoke production --label +0h | +1h | +24h, with both result mails confirmed in the seeded inbox by the release owner (TC-FR1-19-AS-03)
signoffs.production_status_template: tools.protein and tools.diabetes from site/public_html/tools/status.json at the release commit (approved versions = approvals/{protein,diabetes}.json version_hash); no healthy-weight entry until the owner signs FR2-39 AS-19; labels []
